description: Immutable owner-confirmed negative fixtures for the device-layout gate. These are real screenshots from SnapScore 1.0.1 build 32 (New Contest, iPhone 16 Pro 402x874pt, iOS 26) whose layout the owner reported broken (t1547u). Every CI run sends them through the vision step; each MUST come back verdict=fail with a major finding for each requiredRule, or the gate fails itself (rubric-drift detection, scoresnap/e2e/device-layout/lib/vision-selfcheck.mjs). These PNGs are screenshots, NOT hierarchy — geometry negative fixtures (frozen from reproducing the defects on a verified matching build) are tracked by AUG-1376.

ruleLabels.4: excessive dead space / player-card HCP+badge+chip imbalance
ruleLabels.5: A/B team chips below 8pt edge gap
ruleLabels.7: Team Mode switch renders as an unlabeled dark pill
